summary: Merrivoss quote MV-2006-090 (May 22, 2006) to Nimbravelle Medicines Inc: paired Microsomal CLint and Hepatocyte depletion CLint on 24 compounds from the NM08 aminotriazine series. States matrices, cofactor and temperature conditions, no-NADPH and positive controls, matrix acceptance criteria, calculation conventions and reporting bounds, the analytical limits and their exceptions, a five-to-six-week delivery window and a fixed price of $19,200.

title_block.title: Quotation: Paired Liver Systems Clearance
title_block.subtitle: NM08 test article set
lines: Prepared by: Dr M. Larkin, DMPK Study Director

blocks.p: Nimbravelle Medicines Inc has asked Merrivoss Bioanalysis to compare microsomal and hepatocyte clearance for 24 compounds from the NM08 aminotriazine test article set. The aim is to check whether the microsomal ranking holds in a whole-cell system before compounds are chosen for in vivo work.

list: 24 compounds supplied as 10 mM DMSO solutions, 50 µL minimum each, in one accession lot
Structures and molecular weights supplied by the client for LC-MS/MS method set-up
Compounds logged on receipt against the quote reference and stored at -20 °C

rows: Supplier CoA; lot used within its expiry
Viability ≥75% by trypan blue at thaw; lots below this are rejected
table.caption: Table 1 Matrices

rows: 1 µM test article, 37 °C, 1 mM NADPH; organic solvent <0.5%
1 µM test article, 37 °C, 5% CO2, gentle shaking
0, 15, 30, 60, 90, 120 min; heat-inactivated cell control at 120 min
table.caption: Table 2 Design

blocks.p: Samples are quenched in acetonitrile containing internal standard, centrifuged and analyzed by LC-MS/MS. The no-NADPH and heat-inactivated controls distinguish metabolic turnover from chemical instability or nonspecific binding to plastic or protein.

list: Positive control CLint within 0.5-2 times the laboratory historical mean for that matrix lot type
No-NADPH (microsomes) or heat-inactivated (hepatocytes) loss below 15% at the final time point; above this, CLint is reported with a footnote and not used for ranking
Internal standard response within ±30% of the batch mean
Calibration standards within ±20% of nominal (±25% at the lower limit)

blocks.p: CLint is calculated from the first-order depletion rate constant (slope of ln[parent remaining] against time) scaled by protein or cell concentration. Fitted half-lives are reported when at least 20% depletion is observed within the incubation.

list: Microsomes: if depletion over 45 min is below 20%, CLint is reported as an upper bound (<3 µL/min/mg) and half-life as a lower bound (>60 min, the shortest half-life the design can rule out conservatively)
Hepatocytes: if depletion over 120 min is below 20%, CLint is reported as an upper bound (<2 µL/min/10^6 cells)
Censored values are labelled as such in the worksheet and are not used to fit species correlations

blocks.p: The target lower limit of quantitation is 1 nM in incubation matrix. Compounds that ionize poorly or show matrix suppression may need a higher limit; any compound with an achieved limit above 5 nM is reported with its actual limit and a note that the depletion range is reduced. Method set-up is included for all 24 compounds.

list: Assay worksheet (Excel) with depletion curves, CLint and half-life per compound and matrix
Interim microsomal data at the midpoint
Final report with matrix acceptance and analytical limits stated before conclusions

blocks.p: Microsomal data within 3 weeks of compound receipt; hepatocyte data and the final report 5 to 6 weeks from receipt. Target start: week of 06/05/2006, subject to compound arrival.
Fixed price including method set-up. Invoiced on issue of the final report, net 30 days. Quote valid 60 days.

list: Compounds are stable in DMSO stock for the duration of the study
Additional species or metabolite identification would be quoted separately
